arStrings.szText:
{icon:bullet,1.2} After stabbing an enemy in the back or Critically Striking an enemy, your senses heighten, allowing all your hits to count as backstabs and granting {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%x|]{/c} increased Cast Speed and {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 4" * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds. 
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Cutthroat{/c} Skill backstabs have a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"|%|]{/c} chance to make your next {c_important}Agility{/c} Skill free to Cast, up to a maximum of {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"]{/c}.
